caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed outline rendered in black ink on an off-white or slightly yellowed background. The outline consists of a vertically oriented, elongated shape that is widest near the top, gently curving inward before tapering to a point at the bottom. Within the outline, on each side, two short diagonal lines intersect, marking sections that are closer to the upper third of the shape. The overall composition is minimal, with the lone outlined shape centered on a blank, unadorned sheet. There are no additional objects, shading, or colors apart from the background and the black line.
title: Woman's Slipper
